Priya Shah: Heads-up — NovaHealth renewal hits 6/01. Procurement asked for an updated quote with an explicit VAT line and Net-30. They also asked if we can extend term to 18 months. Can finance/legal weigh in? cc @Liam Carter
Liam Carter: 18 months? That changes ARR recognition. What are they asking for on seats/discounts?
Priya Shah: Current commit is 50 seats @ $30/user/mo. Procurement wants 10% off seats over 50 and a ramp to 200 seats over 6 months. They said if we update the quote they can issue PO this week. Samir, any timing on the PO?
Samir Patel: Procurement said PO likely but signer is changing — wants CFO instead of CISO. CFO is OOO until Thu; procurement will hold until Fri. If we don't get PO by EOD Fri they may push renewal to next quarter.
Olivia Nguyen: We need to see the exact signer request. We can't agree to an 18-month term without legal review — need auto-renew language and termination notice clarified. Also need delegation evidence if the CISO will sign. cc @Wei Zhang (Finance)
Samir Patel: Here is the procurement snippet I got: ```Requested: 18 months, Net-30, PO to Redwood Inc, VAT separate line, Signer: CFO (name+title)```
Wei Zhang: 10% volume discount on >50 seats reduces ARR roughly $36k annualized given the ramp. We can approve conditional discounting if there's a minimum spend floor or a tiered ramp. Suggest tiers instead of flat 10% right away. :thinking_face:
Liam Carter: Agree on tiers — safer for unit economics. Proposed tiers: 5% @100 seats, 8% @150, 10% @200 with a signed ramp schedule. Priya, can you propose that to procurement?
Priya Shah: Will propose ramp tiers and add VAT line. Samir — please confirm PO # and expected sign date; if CFO unavailable can procurement accept CISO w/ delegation email?
Olivia Nguyen: CISO can sign only if delegation is documented (email from CFO/legal or an official PO header showing authorized signer). If they can provide that, legal can accept interim signature. Otherwise require CFO signature.
Samir Patel: I'll request delegation email today and push for PO by Friday. If they can't deliver, I can propose an interim MSA addendum to lock pricing until PO is issued.
Emma Park: (Enablement) I can tentatively book onboarding week of 6/10 but will only lock it if PO is received by 6/03. Reserving a 2hr kickoff slot now; will release if no PO. :calendar:
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (draft) for NovaHealth — will update signer when CFO name provided.
Priya Shah: Action items: 1) Samir to request delegation email + chase PO by Fri. 2) Priya to update quote w/ VAT line + ramp tiers and send today. 3) Olivia to pre-review interim addendum language. 4) Emma to hold enablement slot pending PO. I'll update this thread with PO # when it lands. :thumbsup:
